description: The authors use model-based explanations of concept drift to localize anomalies in critical infrastructure. Their Bayesian-network approach represents conditional dependencies and is demonstrated on water-network leaks and sensor faults and on electrical power-system faults. These concrete applications establish the infrastructure condition-monitoring role. The method explains changes in observed variables; the metadata do not establish an independently calibrated hydraulic or electrical network solver.
